inspiration.source_location: webapp/upgrade/4.3.2-to-6.3.2/mysql/port.sql: XML content comparison and extraction expressions
inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration extracts selected values from XML text with EXTRACTVALUE XPath expressions while comparing document content.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored catalog audit. Fixed XML documents expose repeated child text and a positional child lookup through EXTRACTVALUE; the source migration tables, XML payloads, and application context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Catalog 401 has two entries and catalog 402 has one entry. The repeated name path returns space-separated text, while the positional state path returns the second entry only and NULL when absent.
determinism_notes: Catalog IDs, XML documents, XPath expressions, and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE xml_catalog_audit (catalog_id INT PRIMARY KEY, catalog_document TEXT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT catalog_id, EXTRACTVALUE(catalog_document, '/catalog/entry/name') AS entry_names, EXTRACTVALUE(catalog_document, '/catalog/entry[2]/state') AS second_state FROM xml_catalog_audit ORDER BY catalog_id

checks.sql: SELECT catalog_id, catalog_document FROM xml_catalog_audit ORDER BY catalog_id
